propositions: executor.py is 790 LOC, exceeding the 800-LOC hard cap with only 10 lines of headroom

the call graph reveals two disconnected clusters: the step-kind I/O contract model (declaration and static compatibility) versus the run engine (control flow, expression resolution, dispatch, recording)

the contract model cluster (StepContract, STEP_CONTRACTS, contract_for, input_schema_for, shallow_contract_check and helpers) shares no edges with the run engine and can move to a new step_contracts.py module
the run engine cluster (RunState, RunResult, StepContext, STEP_REGISTRY, run_workflow and related functions) remains in executor.py and imports the moved cluster
moved symbols must be re-exported from executor.py so existing import statements remain unchanged and tests pass without modification
